description: handle_dump_heap + safe_proc_read (~90 lines) are offline diagnostics, unrelated to memory monitoring or cleanup coordination. Extract to a plain class src/services/heap_dumper.cr (e.g. HeapDumper.dump(deep : Bool) : String) invoked from the actor handler - keeps actor serialization semantics while giving the dumper its own file, testable without an actor. While there: the nine sequential safe_proc_read calls should become a data-driven list of {proc_file, dest_name} pairs; and remove the dead QuickHeadlines::LibGC lib declaration at the top of memory_manager_actor.cr (duplicate of RefreshLoop::LibGC in refresh_loop.cr; nothing calls it - only a comment references it).
title: Extract HeapDumper from MemoryManagerActor (SRP)
